The reserve only has 4, so only one of us can be safe right away. I intend to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If there's anything left, I'll operate afterward and give back any cells beyond 4.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.
